property_summary: SetMinSum must set MinSum to the given value even before initialization (calling it on a fresh contract yields c.MinSum() == _val).
A successful Collect must not revert and must transfer the withdrawn amount to the caller and reduce their recorded balance accordingly.
Calling SetMinSum twice leaves MinSum equal to the second value (last-write-wins), not the accumulated sum.
SetMinSum overwrites MinSum: after calling it with _val on a contract whose current MinSum is a nonzero s, MinSum must equal _val exactly (not s + _val).
